Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 16
, Reason for Mistake: The agent incorrectly claimed Wikipedia stated Jennings was “buried in Chandler, Arizona” at “Valley of the Sun Mortuary & Cemetery,” without showing the cited text and in contradiction to the previously verified Find a Grave entry listing City of Mesa Cemetery, Mesa, Arizona. This misread/misrepresentation (and likely confusion of funeral location with burial) introduced the wrong burial location and ignored the instruction to extract exact wording with citations.
